name: Aaron Simms
bio: Aaron Simms is a New Yorker from Cincinnati with over thirty years of experience in regional, Off-Broadway, and Broadway theater. He is the founder and Executive Producer of Inwood Art Works in New York City.

name: Stephanie Eiss
bio: Stephanie Eiss is an actor, Applied Theatre practitioner, teaching artist, and arts administrator who has worked in NYC and Connecticut for 15 years with organizations including CUNY Creative Arts Team and Elm Shakespeare.

name: Nick Urda
bio: Contact Nick for school workshops, touring shows, and booking education programs across Fairfield County.
